contentPattern.structure: cover image + breadcrumbs + title + byline + date + read time + category tag

suitableFor: blog and article detail page headers
news/editorial detail pages needing a cover image beside title and byline metadata
pages with an article header showing breadcrumbs, author, publish date, read time, and category tag
notSuitableFor: marketing landing hero with CTA buttons (use hero-split)
full-bleed dark CTA banners with a background image (use hero-overlay)
